reply.shortGloss: to go; to be (health/fit); to fit
reply.emotion: on the move and ready to get going, purposeful and active
notes: Aller is one of the most common irregular verbs in French. It is also used as an auxiliary verb to form the futur composé (e.g., je vais manger).

senses.definition: Se déplacer pour aller d'un endroit à un autre.

examples.translation: I am going to the supermarket.
examples.emotion: ready to head out the door with a clear destination in mind

senses.definition: Être dans tel ou tel état de santé ou de forme.

examples.emotion: warm and friendly, greeting someone with genuine interest

senses.definition: Convenir à quelqu'un, en parlant d'un vêtement ou d'une taille.

examples.text: Cette chemise te va très bien.
examples.translation: This shirt suits you very well.
examples.emotion: approving and pleased, noticing a great look on a friend
